/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
s='''Do not remove the compatibility aliases until the owners of the two remaining clients confirm migration. What changed? What is known? What is tested? What follows? The migration renamed three public fields while retaining compatibility aliases. Twelve of fourteen known clients have migrated—a substantial measure of progress—while the status of two clients remains unknown. Integration tests cover the twelve migrated clients, but not the two clients of unknown status. Thus, the evidence supports continued migration work; however, within its measured limits, it does not support removing the aliases at this point.'''
print(len(s.split()))
PY"
